name: Artist Growth
description:
Artist Growth is how music industry teams actually collaborate across their business — tours, promo, projects, ticket-buys, and everything in between.

The Artist Growth app allows you to search for events, view calendars and day sheets, track ticket requests, and stay up to date with your tasks across your entire roster using natural language.

No digging through spreadsheets. No chasing your team for updates. Just the information you need, when you need it.

Built for artist managers, tour managers, business managers, and anyone in live entertainment who's tired of the chaos.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Artist Growth to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Artist Growth to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.artistgrowth.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Artist Growth MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artist Growth provides these MCP tools: create_ticket_request, get_info, list_artists, list_calendars, list_my_tasks, search_events, and search_ticket_requests.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Artist Growth?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Artist Growth in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Artist Growth MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artist Growth requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Artist Growth is developed by Artist Growth. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
